content.title:
Jana Kramer on Instagram: "Gaslit by My Husband is officially out on Netflix.

This one was a tough story to step into…emotionally heavy and deeply real , but it was also incredibly meaningful to tell and healing for my past. Getting to film this alongside my daughter made it even more special, and sharing scenes with one of my favorite scene partners, @austinnichols made the experience that much better.

Stories like this matter. Because sometimes the hardest truths are the ones that help people feel less alone. If this film reminds even one person to trust their voice and their strength, then it was worth telling. ❤️"

So happy to see you & @austinnichols in something together again!❤️Too bad it’s not on Netflix Canada 😢Wait... so this is the multiverse of Alex and Julian? 😮 This is gonna be so good 🙌🔥Hubby and I saw it on @lifetimetv first last year and it's about to get so much more exposure. And you’re so damn pretty and talented @austinnichols too. And your daughter as Amelia. Any new movies coming up?
